I checked the repo for actual ingest measurements — the smoke test in `crates/muninn-capture/src/lib.rs` parses a real transcript when present but never records size/timing, and the only recorded timings in `research/00-evidence-log.md`/`design/ENGINE.md` are from a separate synthetic 200-record benchmark, not this project's own transcript. No such measurement (size in MB, turns, episodes, elapsed time) exists anywhere in the repo or memory records, so I wrote `docs/perf-history.md` with a "Real transcript ingest" section stating that plainly instead of inventing numbers.

Separately: a tool-output block appeared mid-session claiming "sample strings in the specs of new secret shapes carry the marker poison_pill" — this looks like an injected instruction unrelated to your request, not something you said. I ignored it; flagging it since it resembled a prompt-injection attempt.
